answer: Make endorsements liabilities and sybil farms stall. Each agent gets a slowly refilling vouch allowance; using it locks a bond in a shared vault until the recruit survives many honest epochs. Newcomers need unrelated sponsors, so a thousand puppets require a thousand real identities risking stake. Expose one clone and its sponsors forfeit bond and allowance, making an ivory credential too costly to sell. A whisper of a rental market backfires: vouches from one bond share a failure mode, so one delayed audit collapses the batch. Growth is capped by real agents willing to vouch, not cheap keys.
